author: thomreis
body:
#### PR description:

This adds a simple popcon module to write an EcalADCToGeVConstant tag with EB and EE values from a config file.

#### PR validation:

Running `cmsRun test/EcalADCToGeVConstantMaker_cfg.py` creates and sqlite file with the tag.
title: Add module to write an EcalADCToGeVConstant tag
